images.name: M2
images.prompt: Vintage pen-and-ink engraving illustration, fine cross-hatching and stippling, etched linework like a 19th-century book plate, with subtle muted watercolor washes in ochre, sage and dusty blue, on warm cream aged paper. The subject sits in the center surrounded by plain empty cream paper, no border, no frame. No text, letters, numbers, signatures or watermarks. Still life with no people, no hands and no arms: an old wooden workbench by a small window at dawn, a whetstone with a chisel resting on it, a hammer, a hand plane and a few wood shavings laid out neatly, soft morning light.
